lines.en: I keep low and move steady.
Two hind legs. I run fast.

lines.zh: 六米长的身子，转弯不容易。
lines.en: Six metres of body doesn't turn easily.

lines.zh: 三叠纪最早的恐龙之一，六米长。
lines.en: One of the earliest dinosaurs, six meters long.
I know the Triassic woods.
The soil's soft. My feet sink.

lines.zh: 我一步步压过去，草都倒了。
lines.en: I press forward and grass falls flat.

lines.zh: 我的前肢很短，帮不上忙。
lines.en: My forelimbs are short. Little help.

lines.zh: 尾巴在后面平衡，一直摆。
lines.en: My tail sways behind me, balancing.

lines.zh: 我走的时候，会先看风的方向。
lines.en: Before I move, I check the wind.
There's a scent here. I'll investigate.
I'm not the largest. I'm fast enough.

lines.zh: 我从阿根廷的化石里回来的。
lines.en: I came back from Argentine fossils.
I close in slowly so nothing's startled.
I stand with my head slightly low.
Something's in the wind. I'm sorting it out.

lines.zh: 这个世界的空气，比我那时候湿。
lines.en: The air here is wetter than my time.

lines.zh: 我把头转过来，看了看后面。
lines.en: I turn my head and check behind.

lines.zh: 我最古老的那批恐龙之一。
lines.en: One of the oldest of the dinosaurs.

lines.zh: 三百五十公斤，站着不动也不轻。
lines.en: Three hundred and fifty kilos standing still.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿往里弯，抓着不放。
lines.en: My teeth curve inward. They hold.
No other hunters around here.
I breathe slowly. My throat rattles.

lines.zh: 最早的那批恐龙里，就有我。
lines.en: I'm among the earliest dinosaurs.
Tree shadows shift across my back.

lines.zh: 我在等，等它自己露出来。
lines.en: I'm waiting for it to show itself.
Too quiet. I sniff twice.

lines.zh: 我把爪子在地上刮了一下。
lines.en: I scrape my claws on the ground.
I circle you, sniffing your heels.
I lower my head to your level.
You don't run. Odd.
I sniff. You're alive.

lines.zh: 我绕了半步，看你的侧面。
lines.en: I shift half a step to see your flank.
Your shadow on the ground is small.
No hurry. Let me look at you first.
No companions behind you. Good.
This hide won't be pierced by you.
You raise a hand and my head tilts after it.

lines.zh: 我低声吼了一下，算警告。
lines.en: I growl low. Consider it a warning.

lines.zh: 三趾的爪在土里刨了两下。
lines.en: My three-toed claws rake the soil twice.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，把蕨丛踩倒。
lines.en: I growl low and trample the ferns down.

lines.zh: 这一下打在侧腹，我歪了。
lines.en: That hit my flank and I lurched.
Thick hide. Still hurts.
I turn my head to see who.
I swing my long tail across to guard.

lines.zh: 我把爪子刮在地上，很响。
lines.en: I rake my claws on the ground, loud.
Pain in my flank scrambles my stride.
I'm not down. Don't think it.
The smell of blood makes me fiercer.
I retreat into the tree shadows.
The smell of meat. I know it.
I close in slowly. My feet make no sound.

lines.zh: 六米长、三百五十公斤，站在那里。
lines.en: Six meters long, three hundred fifty kilos.
The moment the meat is down, I stop waiting.
Set it down and step back.
I won't grab. I wait for you to let go.
That smell makes me impatient.
I lower my head and it's in my jaws.
Living beats dead.
I've followed the scent several blocks.
You hit me and go back several steps.

lines.zh: 我纹丝不动，骨头是硬的。
lines.en: I don't shift. Bone is hard.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的林子，我最早到。
lines.en: In Triassic woods I arrived first.
I brush past you, my hide like sandpaper.

lines.zh: 三百五十公斤压在你影子上。
lines.en: Three hundred fifty kilos rest on your shadow.

lines.zh: 六米长的身子，转弯要慢慢来。
lines.en: Six meters long; turning takes me a while.
That flattened the grass.
Six meters of body makes a sound.
You carry my scent now.
Don't stand by my tail.
My low growl rolls between the trees.

lines.zh: 远处也有回应，比我的低。
lines.en: An answer comes. Lower than mine.

lines.zh: 我们绕着走，谁也不先靠近。
lines.en: We circle. Neither closes first.
I lower my head to show no challenge.
This ground is enough for both.
We walk abreast a stretch.
Its teeth are shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 天暗下来，我们各自散开。
lines.en: As it darkens we part.

lines.zh: 这件事，不会有第三者在。
lines.en: No third party in this.

lines.zh: 我们在同一片蕨丛分开。
lines.en: We part inside the same fern thicket.
I take it in my jaws and shake it.
Not edible. I spit it out.
I clamp it with three fingers.
So small I nearly missed it.
Swallowed it whole. No taste.
This one's food. I'll keep it.
I drop it by my feet.
Hard enough to jar my teeth.

lines.zh: 最早的恐龙之一，牙很老。
lines.en: One of the first dinosaurs, with old teeth.

lines.zh: 地上这些东西，我都要看看。
lines.en: Everything on the ground gets checked.
You moved. I stop waiting.

lines.zh: 我压低前半身，后腿绷紧。
lines.en: I drop my front half, hind legs coiled.
This is mine. You shouldn't be here.
I open my jaws. A full row of teeth.

lines.zh: 我不出声，出声你就跑了。
lines.en: I keep quiet; a sound and you'd run.
I work my way to your flank.

lines.zh: 你的背贴上湿漉漉的岩壁。
lines.en: Your back meets the wet rock face.
I bite first. Think later.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的腿，那儿最先软。
lines.en: I watch your legs. They give first.
I've measured the distance.
The wind favors me. Good.
One step brings you into reach.
Growling, I press forward.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，牙缝里还有旧血。
lines.en: I open my mouth; old blood sits between my teeth.
I face you. Never swerving.
You go left; I turn half a beat later.

lines.zh: 我六米的身子慢慢斜过来。
lines.en: My six-meter body angles toward you slowly.
No hurry. Running tires you.

lines.zh: 我绕着走，找最好的角度。
lines.en: I circle to find the best angle.
You snap a dead branch; I am in no hurry.
I haven't made a sound. Only followed.
I reached this ground before you.
The further you go, the less I rush.
Half a circle more and I can bite.

lines.zh: 我压低了头，三叠纪的灌木在晃。
lines.en: I lower my head; Triassic brush sways.
My tail keeps swaying. I'm preparing.
My tail swings left first.
You've stopped. Now.
I don't fear what's in your hand.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，牙扣实了。
lines.en: I bite down and the teeth lock.
My forelimbs press you down.
That knocked you back.
I shake my head and tear something loose.

lines.zh: 我的牙往里弯，咬住不放。
lines.en: My teeth curve in. I don't let go.
Afterward I pull back and watch you.
Light. Only a test.
My tail sweeps and the grass snaps.

lines.zh: 我用力过猛，自己歪了一下。
lines.en: I overcommitted and stumbled.
You retreat. I don't follow.

lines.zh: 这一口，是给你留的记号。
lines.en: That bite will leave a mark.

lines.zh: 我咬住之前先压低喉咙。
lines.en: I drop my growl low before I bite.
The bite misses; I turn at once.
I pant, blood at my jaws.

lines.zh: 我从林子里走出来，先低吼。
lines.en: I step out of the trees and growl first.
Triassic wind again.
Wetter here than I remember.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的土，从我背上落下。
lines.en: Triassic soil slides off my back.
I test the air with my tongue.

lines.zh: 阿根廷的骨头，醒在这片林里。
lines.en: Argentine bones wake in this forest.

lines.zh: 我先绕着界限走了一圈。
lines.en: First I walk my boundary.
My shadow falls on the grass.

lines.zh: 这么大的一块肉，早该有了。
lines.en: Meat this plentiful should have been here sooner.

lines.zh: 我走到低处，这样藏得住。
lines.en: I move low so I stay hidden.
Three-toed claws sink into the wet mud.

lines.zh: 这片林子，从今天开始算我的。
lines.en: These woods are mine from today.
I see something moving.
Let me look before deciding to eat.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，正对光源。
lines.en: I turn slowly toward the light.

lines.zh: 这里的气味很杂，很难分。
lines.en: So many scents here. Hard to sort.
I drop my head and come out from behind a tree.
The weather's wrong. I'm restless.
Fire catches my back and the hide curls.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and a bone cracks.

lines.zh: 河水没过背，我抬不起头。
lines.en: The river covers my back. I can't lift my head.
The blast flips me onto the ground.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进肋侧，走动就疼。
lines.en: Something's in my ribs. Every step hurts.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的骨头，也怕这种东西。
lines.en: Even Triassic bone fears this stuff.
Days without food — my legs have gone soft.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，四条腿都僵。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and all my legs lock.
The Triassic had no emptiness like this.
